dedupe_keys.name: city scale public ev charging transactions and station infrastructure

description: The Beijing public charging deposit pairs anonymized order-level transactions with a station register across all city districts. The current Figshare version two metadata reports about 8.544 million transactions at 8,553 public stations in January and July 2025. Separate Parquet files hold orders for each month and station attributes; a notebook is also listed. The deposit is public under CC BY 4.0. These observations can fit time-of-day charging arrival and facility utilization in an agent-based charger model or help assign electrical load to a network model such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that two selected months cannot establish annual seasonal patterns, and operator-derived transactions may not represent private or workplace charging. Locations are anonymized, so precise feeder mapping requires care and external information. The article is the descriptor; the Figshare DOI is the resource identity. I read the own metadata and file manifest but did not open the large Parquet tables, test spatial accuracy or run the notebook.
